title: 第25章 又一个妖孽第26章 逆天的突破速度
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第25章又一个妖孽？千钧一发之际，陈长安和大黄终于出现。
看到这一人一狗，众人的表情都十分的精彩。
毕竟这样的搭配，可是不多见！
“是他！”
“是他！”
这时，柳乘风和柳梦妍两个人的脸色都变了！
这不就是当日他们在陈家看到的那位陈家老祖吗？
他来了？
他竟然也跟着来了？
“是谁？他是谁？”柳家家主沉声问道。
“当日在陈家，他就是陈正元口中的老祖。”
“陈长安！”
柳乘风的声音很大，不知道是不是因为太过于害怕，这两句话，几乎是用咆哮的方式喊出来的。
“陈家老祖？”
“什么情况？陈家还有老祖？”
“卧槽，我想起来了，当年陈家来到大周国之后，陈家的人曾经说过，陈家好像确实有一位老祖，是被强者带走了。”
“对对对，我想起来了，当时大家其实并没有在意，以为是陈家吹嘘，如果真有这样一位老祖，陈家怎么会来到咱们这。”
“难道说，这一位当真就是陈家的老祖？可他的年纪看起来，好像比陈云轩大不了几岁吧？”
“而且这个修为……凝元境一重？”
陈家老祖现身，这可是一个十分劲爆的消息，所有人都在观察陈长安，不停地议论着。
程玉书此时也有些一头雾水，这陈家，怎么还冒出来一个老祖？
看起来，似乎也并不怎么样吗？
除了样貌英俊的过分了一些，总感觉一无是处，从对方身上察觉不到任何的威胁。
陈长安并没有理会其他人在说些什么，而是向着陈云轩看了过去。
陈云轩的表现，让他也感觉到了惊喜。
之所以让陈云轩独自面对，一方面是陈长安要去找胎珠，但这并不是真正的原因。
陈云轩想要真正的成长，就必须去独自面对各种各样的危机。
磨练从来都不是说说而已，是需要进行实践的。
“诸位抱歉了。”
“我这陈家后辈，可能需要浪费你们一些时间。”
“如果大家不急的话，等一等。”陈长安淡笑着说道。
“你是陈家老祖？”刘伯看向陈长安，眉头紧锁，一时之间不知道应该如何应对。
“怎么？有问题吗？”陈长安笑着问道。
看到陈长安如此云淡风轻，完全没有把他们这些人放在眼里，刘伯也不敢轻举妄动，只能够想着程玉书看去。
程玉书现在也感觉脑子有些不够用了。
content_en:
Chapter 25 Another monster? At the critical moment, Chen Changan and Dahuang finally appeared.
Seeing this man and a dog, everyone's expressions were very wonderful.
After all, such a combination is rare!
"It's him!"
"It's him!"
At this time, the expressions of both Liu Chengfeng and Liu Mengyan changed!
Isn't this the Chen family ancestor they saw at the Chen family that day?
Is he coming?
He actually came too?
"Who is it? Who is he?" the head of the Liu family asked in a deep voice.
"That day at the Chen family, he was the ancestor that Chen Zhengyuan called him."
"Chen Changan!"
Liu Chengfeng's voice was very loud. I don't know if it was because he was too scared. These two sentences were almost shouted in a roar.
"Ancestor of the Chen family?"
"What's going on? There are still ancestors in the Chen family?"
"Damn it, I remembered that after the Chen family came to the Great Zhou Kingdom, people from the Chen family once said that the Chen family seemed to have an ancestor who was taken away by a strong man."
"Yes, yes, I remembered it. At that time, everyone didn't really care. They thought it was the Chen family bragging. If there really is such an ancestor, how could the Chen family come to us."
"Could it be that this person is really the ancestor of the Chen family? But he seems to be a few years older than Chen Yunxuan, right?"
"And this cultivation level is...at the first level of the Condensing Yuan Realm?"
The ancestor of the Chen family appeared. This was very exciting news. Everyone was observing Chen Changan and talking about it non-stop.
Cheng Yushu was also a little confused at this time. Why did an ancestor of the Chen family appear?
Doesn't it look like it's very good?
Apart from his overly handsome appearance, he always felt useless and could not detect any threat from the other party.
Chen Changan didn't pay attention to what others were saying, but looked at Chen Yunxuan.
Chen Yunxuan's performance also surprised him.
The reason why Chen Yunxuan was allowed to face it alone was that Chen Changan wanted to find the fetal beads, but this was not the real reason.
If Chen Yunxuan wants to truly grow, he must face various crises alone.
Training is never just talk, it requires practice.
"I'm sorry, everyone."
"As a descendant of the Chen family, I may need to waste some of your time."
"If you are not in a hurry, wait a moment." Chen Changan said with a smile.
"Are you the ancestor of the Chen family?" Uncle Liu looked at Chen Changan, his brows furrowed, and he didn't know how to respond for a moment.
"What? Is there a problem?" Chen Changan asked with a smile.
Seeing that Chen Changan was so calm and carefree and didn't pay attention to them at all, Uncle Liu didn't dare to act rashly and could only think about Cheng Yushu.
Cheng Yushu also feels that his brain is a little exhausted now.
